title: Understanding the Problem
text: We need to compare the intercept terms from two linear regression models: one using the original design matrix X and the other using the mean-centered design matrix X̃.

title: Intercept in Linear Regression
text: In linear regression, the intercept term is the value of the response variable when all predictors are zero. How does centering affect this?

title: Effect of Centering on Intercept
text: When data is mean-centered, the intercept term represents the mean of the response variable. This is because the predictors are centered around zero.

title: Comparing Intercepts
text: Given that centering affects the intercept, are the intercepts from the two models equal?
